fields.name: time_format_equivalents
fields.desc: List of integers representing the equivalent number of basic units for each time format step (e.g., [1, 7, 30, 365] for Day, Week, Month, Year if basic unit is Day)

fields.name: time_format_names
fields.desc: List of strings for the names of time format steps (e.g., ['Day', 'Week', 'Month', 'Year'])

fields.name: time_basic_unit
fields.desc: The fundamental unit of time measurement (e.g., 'Year', 'Day')

fields.name: time_range_min
fields.desc: The earliest point in time representable or tracked in the world's timeline

fields.name: time_range_max
fields.desc: The latest point in time representable or tracked in the world's timeline

fields.name: time_current
fields.desc: The current point in time within the world's timeline

fields.name: time_format_names
fields.desc: The names of the calendar's steps, e.g. ['Day', 'Week', 'Month', 'Year'].

fields.name: time_format_equivalents
fields.desc: How many time_basic_unit each step of time_format_names holds, in the same order, e.g. [1, 7, 30, 365] when the basic unit is Day.

fields.name: time_basic_unit
fields.desc: The unit every element date and duration counts in (e.g. 'Year', 'Day'): a birth_date of 1200 is 1200 of these.

fields.name: time_range_min
fields.desc: The earliest point of the world's timeline, in time_basic_unit.

fields.name: time_range_max
fields.desc: The latest point of the world's timeline, in time_basic_unit.

fields.name: time_range_current
fields.desc: The world's present moment, in time_basic_unit.
